استسهلن (form X)
# اِسْتَسْهَلْنَ (istashalna) /is.tas.hal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَسْهَلَ (istashala)
# اُسْتُسْهِلْنَ (ustushilna) /us.tus.hil.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَسْهَلَ (istashala)
# اِسْتَسْهِلْنَ (istashilna) /is.tas.hil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَسْهَلَ (istashala)
